name: 合成器录音室

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A miniature synthesizer recording studio: thick insulated double door, sculpted physical sound-wave sign above entrance, dark teal wall panels, amber windows, rounded magenta accent fascia and small roof acoustic vents. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 声波招牌与入口完整，后墙简化；窗口光由运行时控制。
